function: system, p. 3: over-the-air FEEL model aggregation (AirComp power control and denoising factor, area 7) with a single antenna at the edge server and at each device, and no RIS.
notes: Excluded as system (first applicable code). The work passes no_learning (federated learning over the air: the model trained across the devices is the learned element), above_phy (the AirComp transmit power and denoising factor, pp. 4-5 and 8, are designed jointly with CPU frequency and sample-sensing size), and function (p. 4: "All devices use the over-the-air computation (AirComp) technique to synchronously upload their local models to the edge server for aggregation"; problem P3 on p. 8 bounds the AirComp error, so area 7). p. 3: "It is assumed that both the edge server and the devices are equipped with a single antenna for signal transmission"; no RIS anywhere; Table II (p. 9) gives N = 10 devices and no antenna arrays. The resource optimization itself is classical (convex problems, closed-form channel-inversion power control, Lyapunov). If the reviewer reads the sensing-sample allocation as ISAC resources (area 5) instead of area 7, the system code still applies.
